title: Semantic Communication for Noisy Wireless Channels
abstract: This paper studies a compact semantic encoder that preserves task-relevant meaning under noisy channel conditions.

title: Retrieval-Augmented Agents for Paper Monitoring
abstract: This work proposes an agent workflow that retrieves recent research papers, stores evidence, and generates traceable weekly summaries.

title: Evaluation Protocols for LLM-Based Research Assistants
abstract: The paper introduces offline evaluation tasks for research assistants, focusing on citation faithfulness and summary stability.
